name: section-template-context
body:
A section template is executed with the same reserved `deck` and `slide` context as a slide layout, in addition to the section instance's own field values and rendered body. A section therefore can render the current slide's number/total or any deck property — the motivating case is a footer section rendering `{{.slide.number}}/{{.slide.total}}` on the slide it sits on. The context is present at every composition depth: a section template nested inside another section also receives it. Section instance fields stay directly addressable, unchanged; `deck` and `slide` are the only additions.
AC: a footer section template containing `{{.slide.number}} / {{.slide.total}}` on the third slide of a twelve-slide deck renders `3 / 12`; the same section can render `{{.deck.title}}`; a section nested one level deeper still renders both.
